wordmark.name: Broad Voice
wordmark.construction: Every displayed glyph drawn as original paths in source/build_alternatives.py; no font outlines. Broad left strokes, slimmer returns and cut exits form one handwriting grammar.
wordmark.idea: Make the full name a warm, visibly drawn voice.
risks: Can lean toward a café or cultural festival identity; lettering may feel too informal for the parish.
Spacing and the f/P junction remain rough.
The first line is deliberately wider; optical rhythm needs user judgment before refinement.

letterform.name: Open Voice TP
letterform.construction: A lower T shoulder answers a taller P. The open P counter exits through a broad left cut; no enclosing seal.
letterform.idea: A compact open letterform as a counterpart to the full-name and architectural options.
risks: The lower T can read lowercase r in isolation.
Rounded compact geometry can suggest an app or creative studio.
The initial letters need recognition testing before this deserves refinement.
